key_decisions: skipLocalEngine is a NEW flag, deliberately NOT autoConnectOnStart. Auto-connect spins a BILLED Pod at every launch (storage.js:57-59 says the OFF default exists to prevent exactly that), and 'don't make me install an engine I'll never use' must not imply 'bill me on every app open'. Reusing it would also drag in auto-connect's retry lifecycle (MPI-85/110).

The hatch is ALWAYS shown on the setup phase, with no gpu.vendor gate. MPI-387 F2 had just documented that detectIntelArcGPU matches Arc/Data-Center only, so Iris/UHD/HD fall through BY DESIGN - a detection-gated hatch would re-trap exactly the users it exists for. upgrading/repairing modes are excluded: a local engine already exists there.

The no-engine gate sits on the three landing-page doors, NOT on the operations that fail. The user's argument settled it: 'Open in file system' is a landing-page right-click, so gating entry costs the user nothing, while gating what fails needs five guards and grows by one per tool added.
models:open / apps:open are gated on the LISTENER in shell.js, not the landing-nav emitters, so the Gallery radial's emitters are covered by the same check.

The hatch does NOT auto-open Settings. First launch - exactly when needsInstall is true - also runs the 18+ maturity gate and the changelog overlay, and navigation calls Overlays.reset(). Auto-opening a slide-over into that chain is the MPI-333 double-backdrop bug. The destination is named in the button copy instead.
